before.gloss: Jesus told His disciples this parable:
The kingdom of heaven is like a householder
Having agreed with the laborers on a denarius a day,
I will give you whatever is fair
But about the eleventh hour he went out
Why do you stand here idle all day?
And when evening had come, the lord of the vineyard says to his steward:
When those who had arrived about the eleventh hour came, they received a denarius each
But when the first also came, they thought
but they too received a denarius each
And on receiving it, they murmured
you have made them equal to us
the burden of the day and of heat
But he answered one of them, saying:
Did you not agree with me on a denarius?
but I want to give this last worker the same as you
Or is it not lawful for me to do what I want?
